To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

The expression of the activating protein (AP-1)-family of oncogenes, c-Jun and c-fos, in the rat adrenal cortex is correlated with in vivo adrenocorticropic hormone (ACTH) and fibroblast growth factors (FGF) proliferation.
Jun/Fos protein expression and DNA synthesis in the adrenal cortex are induced after in situ infusion with ACTH, and are antagonized by FGF2.
the adrenal cortex expresses the early response genes c-Fos and c-Jun and their family member FosB.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of cell proliferation and cell differentiation in the adrenal cortex.
the study of the expression pattern of Jun and Fos oncogenes and the role of the AP-1 complex in the adrenal cortex after treatment in vitro and in vivo with ACTH, FGF2, or both.
the study of the expression pattern of AP-1 family proteins in the adrenal cortex of the rat, in relation to the proliferative response of adrenal cells to ACTH and FFG2.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the expression of AP- 1 family members is a good indicator of the trophic action of ACTH, but is not the only factor controlling adrenal cell proliferation.
Fos and Jun are expressed in the adrenal gland in a pattern that is consistent with the proliferative response to ACTH.
the expression of AP- 1 factors in adrenal cortex is correlated with proliferation and that the composition of the AP-1 complexes varies in the different zones of the adrenal cortex.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Fos and Jun are expressed in the adrenal gland in response to ACTH.
the expression of AP- 1 factors is correlated with the in vivo proliferative response to ACTH and FosB expression in the zona reticulata.
Fos and Jun proteins are expressed in the adrenal cortex in a zonal and hormonal dependent fashion.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the composition of the AP-1 complex is correlated with proliferation in these zones.
the AP-1 factors c-Jun, c-Fos, FosB, and FosB are induced in the zona fascicularis and zona reticulars by ACTH, and in the zona fascicultaris and zona reticular by FGF2.
the AP-1 proteins are involved in adrenal cell proliferation, but their expression is not sufficient to stimulate proliferation.
